scientific_integrity: Finite-state exact symbolic proof and separately structured rational-history enumeration; established exponential Richardson/first-passage equivalence is cited, not claimed as novel.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies only to the three-cube with directional edge rates (1,1,t), t>0. No all-dimensional or fully anisotropic three-rate optimization is proved. Absolute historical uniqueness is unverified; external independent scientific validation has not occurred.
title: Homogeneous directional rates uniquely maximize geodesic growth on the three-cube
